basic_info.description:
Location, Location, Location!
This charming 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo with a 1-car garage, hardwood flooring  is ready for its new owner. The spacious living room, with large double-pane windows and a cozy wood-burning fireplace, flows seamlessly into the formal dining area and well-appointed kitchen.
A large hallway closet, convenient half bath, and full bath with  a standing shower and soaking tub provide comfort and functionality. The basement includes a studio apartment currently rented month-to-month for $1,400an excellent opportunity for added income.
Located in the desirable Richmond District, this home offers easy access to vibrant shops, dining, parks, transit, and the beauty of Ocean Beach an ideal setting for enjoying San Francisco living at its finest.
